'''Caf Treblanc''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a conflict fought between the Alliance and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="anh" /> By [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the [[Royal Award Ceremony/Legends|Royal Award Ceremony]], which Caf Treblanc was present in, to [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]].</ref> Treblanc had attained the position of [[Chief/Legends|chief]] in the Alliance.<ref name="Insider">{{InsiderCite|133|Rogues Gallery|Rogues Gallery: Celebrating a Rebel Victory!}}</ref> [[0 BBY/Legends|Immediately preceding]] 0 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|ABY]],<ref name="NEC note">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] to [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]].</ref> the Alliance managed to [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|destroy]] the Imperial [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|DS-1 Orbital Battle Station]] [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]] near the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]].<ref name="anh" />

Following the victory, the [[Royal Award Ceremony/Legends|Royal Award Ceremony]] was held in the [[Grand Audience Chamber]] of the [[Great Temple/Legends|Great Temple]], the Alliance's base on Yavin 4. Treblanc was present in the ceremony, standing on a raised dais behind Rebel fighters [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], who were honored for their actions during the battle. Fair-skinned with a [[Color/Legends|brown]] [[Hair/Legends|moustache]], Treblanc [[Clothing/Legends|wore]] a white [[Alliance military uniform|uniform]] with a [[Helmet/Legends|helmet]].<ref name="anh" />

==Behind the scenes==
Caf Treblanc first appeared as an uncredited Rebel extra seen during the award ceremony honoring the [[Heroes of Yavin/Legends|Heroes of Yavin]] at the end of [[1977]]'s [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']] film.<ref name="anh" /> In [[June]] [[2012]], the character was named by "[[Rogues Gallery (department)|Rogues Gallery]]," a feature published in [[Star Wars Insider 133|''Star Wars Insider'' 133]].<ref name="Insider" /> At least one other character in the ''[[Star Wars]]'' universe shared Treblanc's surname. [[Romeo Treblanc]] was the name given via [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace's]] "[[What's The Story?]]" feature to a character seen in the [[prequel trilogy]] films [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']] and [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']], respectively.<ref name="Treblanc">{{DB|character|romeotreblanc|Treblanc, Romeo}}</ref> However, it has not been [[canon]]ically established if the two characters had any relation with each other.
